Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Nassau hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 14 of the 15 Nassau hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 3, Vio.com at 3, Billabook.com at 2, Amimir.com at 1, Bluepillow.id at 1, BusinessHotels.com at 1, KAYAK.com at 1, Traveluro at 1 and 1 other site at 1 between them. These are the Nassau rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 13 of the 14 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Taxes and fees at Nassau hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 10% ($34 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 8% at The Coral at Atlantis to 21% at Grand Hyatt Baha Mar. At 2 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
